THE LEAGUE WAY

A new contest every basho.

Managers draft six Makuuchi rikishi in a snake draft. Five compete, one waits in reserve. The five highest-ranked leftovers form Nokori-Goba.

Live scoring is local to this browser; sharing standings across devices still requires a backend.

PRE-BASHO RITUAL

The snake draft

Six managers select six wrestlers each. Draft order is randomized, and reverses every round. Absent managers receive the highest-ranked available rikishi automatically.

UNDRAFTED CHALLENGER

The seventh heya

Once all 36 picks are complete, the five highest-ranked remaining Makuuchi rikishi automatically form Heya 7, regardless of participation status.

Interactive picking and automatic banzuke imports are planned for the next build. This screen demonstrates the draft structure.
SCORING RULES

Every bout matters.

MATCHDAY WORKFLOW

Results, without the busywork.

  1. Import official Makuuchi results
  2. Review wins, fusen, and kyūjō
  3. Approve the day's results
  4. Recalculate standings automatically
Official result importing is a planned integration, not yet active.
COMMISSIONER HQ · WORKING SCORING LAB

The scoring engine lives here now.

Enter individual rikishi results, apply substitutions, and import/export scoring CSVs below. This workspace runs locally in your browser. Standings and heya pages update automatically from this scoring workspace in your browser.

Spreadsheet workflow: Draft stays untouched. The BASHO tab is the scoring tab we will map next. The CSV bridge is manual for now; it does not modify your workbook.
BASHO SPREADSHEET BRIDGE · v1.4

Import your actual BASHO results

I mapped the 30 active rikishi and their recorded wins directly from your BASHO tab. Download the prepared CSV, then use Import scoring rows (CSV) in the Scoring Lab below. This does not edit either spreadsheet tab.

Before importing: Export a JSON backup from the Scoring Lab. The CSV sets these completed records to final and replaces results for the matching 30 rikishi.

What still needs verification?
  • Fusen deductions for D.S.F.G and Kiss My Mawashi aren't attributed to individual wrestlers.
  • Special prizes, kinboshi, torinaoshi, and yūshō aren't individually attributed in BASHO.
  • Nokori-Goba isn't in the source BASHO scoring table.
  • Reserves and past substitutions need separate review.

This is a one-time spreadsheet-to-website import, not automatic live Google Sheets syncing yet.

COMMISSIONER HQ · BACKUPS & ARCHIVES

Data is still stored locally in this browser, not in the Google Sheets backend.

Tip: Export your scoring data regularly to keep a backup. This is a local prototype, not a password-protected commissioner portal yet.
